annotations.text:
C · Survey then drill — chosen

The board reads as an overview first: the clock full width, then brief, route and references as three equal cards. The selected requirement opens as one gold-edged workbench below.

Known tradeoff: the evidence starts below the fold. Worth watching once this is in code — if it bites, the survey row is the part to shrink.

A · Instrument bench — not chosen

The timeline and the route as one pinned clock above three parallel evidence columns.

Tradeoff: dense. The route map shrinks to a 430px inset and its labels go with it.

B · Reading room — not chosen

Three rails: requirements left, evidence at full reading width, a context column right that never scrolls away.

Tradeoff: four rails of chrome, and a vertical timeline loses the shape of the record at a glance.
